title: MedAstra: ASR-less Speech Retrieval with Diagnostic Grounding for Medical QA
abstract: arXiv:2611.01261v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Spoken medical question answering can fail when automatic speech recognition (ASR) corrupts a clinically important term before retrieval. We present MedAstra, a framework that maps frozen WavLM speech representations through a lightweight adapter into a frozen E5 text embedding space. This enables a dense retrieval path that accepts a waveform without a query transcript. Retrieved passages and speech-linked textual metadata support answer generation with entity alternatives, diagnostic contrasts, relation heuristics, and bounded retrieval refinement. ASR-less refers to the initial speech retrieval interface; lexical retrieval, string-based entity correction, and the text generator require textual inputs. The deterministic speech embedding does not constitute a calibrated model of acoustic uncertainty. translated_title: MedAstra：面向医疗问答的基于诊断依据支撑的无ASR语音检索
translated_abstract: 口语化医疗问答在自动语音识别（ASR）破坏临床重要术语时可能导致检索失败。我们提出了MedAstra框架，该框架通过轻量级适配器将冻结的WavLM语音表示映射到冻结的E5文本嵌入空间中。这使得密集检索路径能够直接接受语音波形输入而无需查询转录文本。检索到的段落以及与语音关联的文本元数据支持答案生成，包括实体备选项、诊断对比、关系启发式规则和有界检索细化。“无ASR”指的是初始语音检索接口；词法检索、基于字符串的实体校正和文本生成器仍需要文本输入。确定性的语音嵌入并不构成对声学不确定性的校准模型。报告的检索结果显示，纯语音检索器达到87.6的Recall@10，混合配置达到90.4，相比之下（基线为）81.0。
tldr: MedAstra提出了一种无需ASR转写的医疗语音问答检索框架，通过轻量级适配器将冻结的WavLM语音表示映射到冻结的E5文本嵌入空间，实现直接从语音波形进行密集检索，纯语音检索器Recall@10达到87.6，混合配置达到90.4，优于基线的81.0。
